headline: Pharvaris tightens RAPIDe-3 primary completion date
whatHappened: Pharvaris revised the RAPIDe-3 primary completion date from Q3 2026 to Q2 2026 on ClinicalTrials.gov (illustrative).
whyItMatters: A tighter readout timeline compresses the sebetralstat first-mover window. Confirm via IR channels and update launch-defense scenario plans.

headline: Pharvaris hires Head of Commercial, US
whatHappened: Senior commercial hire announced (illustrative), from a company with a recent rare disease launch.
whyItMatters: Senior commercial builds at this stage signal confidence in the readout and imminent commercial infrastructure buildout. Map against KalVista field plans.

headline: Takeda publishes 3-year pediatric lanadelumab safety extension
whatHappened: Long-term safety data in patients aged 2 to 11 published in JACI.
whyItMatters: Reinforces Takhzyro pediatric positioning and will anchor KOL talking points. Informs KalVista pediatric on-demand timing considerations.

headline: BioCryst Orladeyo pediatric Phase III interim safety update
whatHappened: Favorable safety profile at interim cutoff presented at AAAAI 2026 (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Pediatric oral prophylaxis progression continues on track. No immediate implication for sebetralstat on-demand but tightens pediatric oral landscape for KVD824.

headline: Pharvaris confirms rolling filing strategy under Fast Track
whatHappened: Company reaffirmed intention to pursue rolling submission for deucrictibant on-demand following RAPIDe-3 readout (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Rolling submission could shorten post-readout-to-approval timeline by roughly 6 months. Supports an H2 2027 US launch scenario.

headline: Takeda hires new VP, Rare Immunology Commercial
whatHappened: Commercial leadership hire from Sanofi (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Commercial reinforcement ahead of anticipated oral competition. Watch for follow-on hires across medical affairs and market access.

headline: BioCryst Q1 2026 earnings call scheduled
whatHappened: Call scheduled for May 6, 2026.
whyItMatters: Expect commentary on Orladeyo growth and competitive positioning. Flag for real-time monitoring.

headline: Deucrictibant Phase II follow-up analyses posted as preprint (illustrative)
whatHappened: Pre-specified sub-group analyses from CHAPTER-1 shared as preprint ahead of EAACI 2026.
whyItMatters: Preview of sub-population positioning (e.g., severe phenotypes). Anticipate seeds of launch messaging against sebetralstat.

headline: Post-hoc analysis: lanadelumab effect on attack severity
whatHappened: Published in Allergy. Argues prophylaxis reduces both frequency and severity of breakthrough attacks.
whyItMatters: Intended to blunt on-demand-only positioning. Relevant for KalVista positioning against prophylaxis-first messaging.

headline: Pharvaris signs ex-US manufacturing partnership
whatHappened: Undisclosed CMO agreement for commercial-scale manufacturing (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Pre-commercial manufacturing readiness locking in. Consistent with approval-and-launch planning in 18 to 24 months.

headline: BioCryst Chief Commercial Officer transition announced
whatHappened: CCO transition announced (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Leadership change often signals strategy recalibration. Watch next earnings call for commercial priorities.

headline: CHMP positive opinion for Takhzyro quality-of-life label update
whatHappened: EMA CHMP issued positive opinion on AE-QoL language update (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Positions Takhzyro for payer conversations on patient-reported benefit. KalVista should prepare counter-PRO evidence.

headline: Pharvaris Q4 2025 cash position: $280M (illustrative)
whatHappened: Runway reported into late 2027, covering readout, filing, and launch prep.
whyItMatters: Reduces financing overhang that might have forced a deal. Makes independent launch scenario more likely.

headline: Real-world PRO study in Orladeyo patients published
whatHappened: Industry-sponsored PRO study in ~300 patients in Allergy and Asthma Proceedings.
whyItMatters: Validates oral route benefits broadly. Can be leveraged by KalVista as modality-level evidence supporting oral on-demand positioning.

headline: Takeda Q4 2025 earnings: HAE cited as cornerstone franchise
whatHappened: Management reiterated HAE among top rare disease growth contributors.
whyItMatters: No evidence of divestiture consideration. Expect continued aggressive defense of Takhzyro share.

headline: RAPIDe-3 completes enrollment ahead of schedule
whatHappened: Full enrollment announced (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Removes enrollment risk from readout timeline. Supports confidence in Q3 2026 topline.

headline: Takeda presents RWE analysis at AAAAI 2026
whatHappened: Multinational registry analysis of approximately 1,200 Takhzyro patients (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Reinforces real-world adherence and attack rate reduction narrative. Anchor data for prophylaxis defense through 2026.

headline: Pharvaris posts ~15 commercial and market access roles
whatHappened: LinkedIn job listings increase noted (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Commercial scale-up in motion. Expect visible field presence by late 2026.

headline: BioCryst hiring in EU medical affairs
whatHappened: Approximately 6 new medical affairs roles posted in EU (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Suggests preparation for pediatric label launch and / or defensive response to oral on-demand entrants in EU.

headline: NEJM publishes deucrictibant Phase II on-demand data
whatHappened: Peer-reviewed publication in NEJM.
whyItMatters: High-profile placement raises KOL familiarity ahead of Phase III readout. Strengthens pre-launch perception of deucrictibant.

headline: Takeda extends HAEi patient advocacy partnership to 2028
whatHappened: Multi-year extension announced.
whyItMatters: Patient community anchoring. Reduces advocacy-group neutrality for competing launches.

headline: BioCryst initiates Phase I for extended-release oral kallikrein inhibitor
whatHappened: First-in-human dosing initiated (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Long-term oral-prophylaxis pipeline continues. Relevant to KVD824 positioning, minimal near-term sebetralstat impact.

headline: Pharvaris hires VP Medical Affairs from Vertex
whatHappened: Senior MA leadership hire (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Rare disease launch experience being recruited in. Expect aggressive KOL engagement starting Q2 2026.

headline: FDA accepts Orladeyo sNDA for label update
whatHappened: Supplemental filing with long-term OLE data accepted (illustrative). PDUFA Q3 2026.
whyItMatters: Durability narrative strengthened for Orladeyo. Peripheral to sebetralstat on-demand positioning.

headline: HAEi Global Conference 2025: Pharvaris dual-program showcase
whatHappened: Three oral presentations across on-demand and prophylaxis programs.
whyItMatters: Explicit 'one drug, two indications' framing previewed. This is the positioning KalVista will need to counter at launch.
